plain: To reach a conclusion by reasoning from known facts

webster.text: To draw from; to bring from.

example.quote: If we will arbitrarily suppose the contrary, we may deduce any inferences we please from the supposition; for it is certainly possible, by an injudicious exercise of the authorities of the best government that ever was, or ever can be instituted, to provoke and precipitate the people into the wildest excesses.
